## Figure 5B
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 3.5, fig.height = 7, fig_5B}
DC_palette <- c("cDC1" = '#B8ABE0', "cDC2" = '#7F3F98', "DC: PIGR, RORC" = '#FFC857', "CD14" = "#36565C")

CFSE_data <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/figure_panels/data/fig_5_data/combined_CFSE_stats.csv") %>%
    mutate(cell_category = factor(cell_category, levels = c("CD14", "DC: PIGR, RORC", "cDC1", "cDC2")))

stats <- CFSE_data %>%
    filter(cell_category %in% c('DC: PIGR, RORC', 'CD14')) %>%
    t_test(log_CFSE_neg_perc ~ cell_category, paired = TRUE) %>%
    add_significance() %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "cell_category") %>%
    mutate(p_label = paste0("p = ", round(p, 3)))

stats$clean_pvals <- sapply(stats$p, function(x) {
    if (x > 0.01) {
        return(as.character(round(x, 2)))
    } else if (x < 0.01 & x > 0.001) {
        return(as.character(round(x, 3)))
    } else {
        formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 0)
    }
})

ggplot(CFSE_data, aes(x = factor(cell_category), y = log_CFSE_neg_perc)) +
    geom_jitter(pch = 21, size = 5, width = 0.1, height = 0, aes(fill = cell_category)) +
    xlab("Cell category") +
    ylab("log(CFSE- percentage)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = DC_palette) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(data = stats, label = "p = {clean_pvals}", size = 7) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

# ggsave("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/fig_5b.pdf", width = 3.5, height = 7)
## Supplement ##
paper_ids <- read.csv("/projects/home/nealpsmith/projects/ascites/data/patient_paper_ids.csv")
CFSE_data %>% dplyr::left_join(paper_ids, by = "patient_id") %>%
    dplyr::select(cell_category, paper_id, CFSE_pos, CFSE_neg, log_CFSE_pos_perc, log_CFSE_neg_perc) %>%
    write.csv("/projects/home/nealpsmith/projects/ascites/data/plot_data/fig_5b.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Figure 5C
```{r fig 5c, message = F, warning = F, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8}


all_de_res <- read.csv("/projects/home/nealpsmith/projects/ascites/mlr/data/combined_fastq/degs/mlr_all_de_res.csv")

## Volcano plots for manuscript ##
volcano_label_genes <- list("cfse_pos" = c("IFNG", "IFITM3", "STAT2", "LAG3", "CD40LG",
                                           "IL16", "CTSL", "CD27", "NR4A1", "CD96"),
                            "cfse_neg" = c("OSM", "CCL4", "IFNG", "IL3", "LAG3", "SOCS1",
                                           "STMND1", "FGFBP2", "RORA", "IL16", "CD28"))
plot_list <- list()
for (group in c("cfse_pos", "cfse_neg")){
  volcano_df <- all_de_res %>%
    dplyr::filter(lineage == "all", cfse_status == group, contrast == "newDC_vs_DC2")
  label_genes <- volcano_label_genes[[group]]

  p <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(pvalue))) +
    geom_point(data = volcano_df %>% dplyr::filter(padj > 0.1), color ="grey") +
    geom_point(data = volcano_df %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.1, log2FoldChange > 0), color ="orange") +
    geom_point(data = volcano_df %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.1, log2FoldChange < 0), color ="purple") +
    geom_label_repel(data = volcano_df %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% label_genes), aes(label = gene), size = 10) +
    ggtitle(glue("All {group} PRDC vs cDC2")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 20)
  plot_list <- c(plot_list, list(p))

}
ggarrange(plotlist = plot_list)
ggsave("/projects/home/nealpsmith/projects/ascites/figures/resubmission/fig_panels/fig_5c.pdf",
       width = 15, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)

```

## Figure 5D
```{r fig_5d, message = F, warning = F, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}

dc1_increase <- all_de_res %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast == "DC1_vs_DC2", log2FoldChange > 0, padj < 0.1) %>%
  .$gene %>% unique(.)
prdc_increase <- all_de_res %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast == "newDC_vs_DC2", log2FoldChange > 0, padj < 0.1) %>%
  .$gene %>% unique(.)

left <- length(dc1_increase)
right = length(prdc_increase)
overlap <- length(intersect(dc1_increase, prdc_increase))

up_vd <- draw.pairwise.venn(left, right, overlap, category = c("cDC1", "PRDC"),
                   fill = c("#c7bcdc", "#ffd37e"), cat.pos = c(360, 390),
                   alpha = c(0.75, 0.75))
grid.draw(up_vd);
grid.newpage();

supp_table_df_dc2_up <- data.frame("cat" = rep("increased vs cDC2", 3), "comp" = c("cDC1", "DC_RORC", "both"),
                            "n_genes" = c(left, right, overlap))

dc1_decrease <- all_de_res %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast == "DC1_vs_DC2", log2FoldChange < 0, padj < 0.1) %>%
  .$gene %>% unique(.)
prdc_decrease <- all_de_res %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast == "newDC_vs_DC2", log2FoldChange < 0, padj < 0.1) %>%
  .$gene %>% unique(.)

left <- length(dc1_decrease)
right = length(prdc_decrease)
overlap <- length(intersect(dc1_decrease, prdc_decrease))

down_vd <- draw.pairwise.venn(left, right, overlap, category = c("cDC1", "PRDC"),
                   fill = c("#c7bcdc", "#ffd37e"), cat.pos = c(360, 390),
                   alpha = c(0.75, 0.75))

# pdf("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/fig_5d.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
grid.draw(down_vd);
grid.newpage();
# dev.off()


supp_table_df_dc2_down <- data.frame("cat" = rep("decreased vs cDC2", 3), "comp" = c("cDC1", "DC_RORC", "both"),
                            "n_genes" = c(left, right, overlap))

supp_table_df <- rbind(supp_table_df_dc2_up, supp_table_df_dc2_down)
write.csv(supp_table_df, "/projects/home/nealpsmith/projects/ascites/data/plot_data/fig_5d.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Figure 5E
```{r fig5e, message = F, warning = F, fig.width = 3.5, fig.height = 12}
hmap_genes <- all_de_res %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast == "newDC_vs_DC2", padj < 0.1) %>%
  .$gene %>% unique()

cfse <- "cfse_neg"

hmap_df_neg <- all_de_res %>% dplyr::filter(contrast == "newDC_vs_DC2", cfse_status == "cfse_neg",
                             gene %in% hmap_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(lineage, gene, log2FoldChange) %>%
  reshape2::dcast(gene~lineage, value.var = "log2FoldChange") %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  # column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("gene", "all_neg", "cd4_neg", "cd8_neg"))


hmap_df_pos <- all_de_res %>% dplyr::filter(contrast == "newDC_vs_DC2", cfse_status == "cfse_pos",
                             gene %in% hmap_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(lineage, gene, log2FoldChange) %>%
  reshape2::dcast(gene~lineage, value.var = "log2FoldChange") %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  # column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("gene","all_pos", "cd4_pos", "cd8_pos"))


hmap_df <- full_join(hmap_df_neg, hmap_df_pos, by = "gene") %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene")

column_split = c("CFSE-", "CFSE-", "CFSE-", "CFSE+", "CFSE+", "CFSE+")
heatmap_col_fun = colorRamp2(c(min(hmap_df), 0, max(hmap_df)), c("purple", "black", "yellow"))
clustering = hclust(dist(hmap_df, method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2")
row_hc <- as.dendrogram(clustering)

# label_genes <- read.csv('/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/figure_panels/data/fig_5_data/fig_5e_heatmap_markers.csv')
# label_genes <- label_genes %>%
#   dplyr::filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
#   .$gene_symbol
# label_genes %in% rownames(hmap_df)
label_genes <- c("BCL6", "CCL3", "CD27", "CD28", "CD40LG", "CD70", "CD96", "CTSL", "CXCR3", "DUSP5", "FASLG", "GZMH",
                 "HLA-DRA", "IFIT3", "IFITM3", "IFNG", "IL13", "IL16", "IL2", "IL2RA", "IL3", "IL4I1", "IL5", "IL7R",
                 "IL9R", "LAG3", "LAIR1", "LGALS3", "NR4A3", "OAS2", "SOCS2", "STAT2", "TCF7", "TNF", "TNFRSF9",
                 "TNFSF13B", "TOX2", "HMGN2", "LIMD2", "OAS3", "IFIT3")

hmap = Heatmap(hmap_df, col = heatmap_col_fun, name = "log2FC",
        cluster_columns = FALSE,column_split = column_split,
        cluster_rows = row_hc, show_row_names = FALSE) +
    rowAnnotation(link = anno_mark(at = match(label_genes, rownames(hmap_df)),labels = label_genes,
                                 labels_gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 15)))
draw(hmap)

```

```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 6, fig_5G}
data <- read.csv("/projects/home/nealpsmith/projects/ascites/data/spatial/overenrichment_revision_with_lfc.csv") %>%
  # dplyr::filter(DCsteve_anno != "DC_new") %>%
  arrange(desc(foldchangeabundance))
data$DCsteve_anno[data$DCsteve_anno == "DC_new"] <- "DC_RORC"
data$DCsteve_anno <- factor(data$DCsteve_anno, levels = rev(data$DCsteve_anno))
# data$foldchangeabundance[data$foldchangeabundance > 3] = 3
ggplot(data, aes(x = log(foldchangeabundance), y = DCsteve_anno)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  ylab("") +
  xlab("log(fold change abundance)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 17)

```
